# SnapList — Terms of Service

> **DRAFT — not legal advice.** Prepared for Bert and external counsel review. Items marked
> `[COUNSEL]` require a decision before launch. This is a template, not a clickwrapped agreement.
> It assumes the data flows and subprocessors in `docs/LEGAL.md` §6.

Version: 0.1 (draft) · Last updated: 2026-11-06

## 1. Who we are

SnapList ("we", "us") provides a tool that turns a seller's garment photo into a listing-ready
asset pack: a prettified image, detected attributes, written copy, and a marketplace export.
Contact: [support@ — set at launch].

## 2. Eligibility

You must be at least 18 and able to form a binding contract. You are responsible for your account
and for keeping access to your email secure.

## 3. What the service does — and does not do

- We process the photos you upload to produce a cutout, a prettified image, detected attributes,
  listing copy, and an export file or copy block.
- **We do not list on your behalf.** v1 produces a file or text that you upload or paste to a
  marketplace. We do not log into marketplaces, store marketplace credentials, or create listings
  for you. See `docs/EXPORT.md`.
- **We do not set your price or category.** Those are your decisions and are flagged as manual.
- On-model rendering is a Pro feature and depends on third-party providers. Where a provider
  cannot render, we say so and do not consume a paid render credit.

## 4. Your content and licence

- You keep ownership of your garment photos and of the listing asset you export.
- You grant us a limited licence to host, process, and generate derived assets from your photos
  solely to provide the service, including sending them to the subprocessors named in the Privacy
  Policy.
- You confirm you have the right to upload the photo, and that any person visible in it has
  consented to that upload. Do not upload images of people who have not consented.
- **Generated on-model images.** We own the synthetic model references and the rendering
  pipeline. We license the resulting composition to you for use in your own listings. You may not
  resell the model references themselves or represent a synthetic model as a real person.

## 5. Acceptable use

Do not upload unlawful content, images of minors, or images of people who have not consented; do
not use the service to impersonate a real person; do not attempt to extract model references; do
not resell access; do not use the export in violation of a marketplace's terms. We may suspend
accounts that do.

## 6. Brand and attribute accuracy

Detected attributes are suggestions, not guarantees. Brand names are **user-asserted**: the copy
generator will not state a brand or fibre the image did not support, but you must verify any brand
you publish. You are responsible for the accuracy of your listing.

## 7. Plans, billing, and cancellation

- Free tier: a limited number of successful exports, no card.
- Starter and Pro: monthly subscription via Stripe Checkout. Prices and item limits are shown in
  the app before purchase (Starter $19/mo = 100 items; Pro $49/mo = 400 items + on-model).
- Subscriptions renew until cancelled; you can cancel in the app. `[COUNSEL: refund policy, tax
  handling, and auto-renewal disclosures by jurisdiction.]`
- Failed renders do not consume a paid render credit.

## 8. Availability, changes, and liability

We may change or discontinue features and aim to give notice of material changes. `[COUNSEL:
warranty disclaimer, limitation of liability, indemnity, governing law, and dispute resolution —
none of these are set yet and must not be invented in-product.]`

## 9. Termination

You may stop using the service and delete your account at any time. On deletion we remove your
uploads and derived assets as described in the Privacy Policy, except where law requires
retention.

## 10. Contact

[support@] · [privacy@] — set at launch.
